name: Crafton.pl AEO SEO Auditor
author: crafton.pl

sections.description:
Crafton.pl AEO SEO Auditor adds a live analysis panel to your WordPress editor that scores your content as you write. It checks every post and page against five essential SEO and AEO criteria and returns an instant percentage score, so your content is ready to rank — in search engines and in AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).

All analysis runs locally in your browser via JavaScript: no external API calls, no account, no data leaving your site.

The 5 Scoring Criteria

  1. Word count — minimum 300 words for substantive, indexable content.
  2. H1 heading — exactly one per page, for a clear topical signal.
  3. H2 subheadings — structure content into sections AI engines can extract and cite.
  4. Image alt text — verifies alt tags for accessibility and machine readability.
  5. Paragraph length — short paragraphs, optimized for readability and conversational indexing.

Each criterion updates live and contributes to a single Optimization Score (0–100%).

How do I use the plugin?

  1. Activate the plugin and go to Posts > Add New (or Pages > Add New).
  2. Find the Crafton.pl AEO SEO Auditor box in the editor — works with both Gutenberg and the Classic Editor.
  3. Write your content and watch the checklist turn green: add your H1 title, insert H2 subheadings, add alt text to images, keep paragraphs short, and reach 300 words to hit 100%.

How do I test the plugin?

  1. Activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Posts > Add New.
  3. Add text, H1/H2 headings, and an image with alt text to observe the real-time scoring updates in the meta box.

Does this plugin send my content to external servers?

No. The plugin is 100% client-side. All content analysis runs locally in your browser via JavaScript. There are zero external API calls, no third-party services, no tracking, and no accounts required.

Who built this plugin?

This plugin is developed and maintained by Crafton, a UX-driven web design and development agency founded in 2010, headquartered in Poznań, Poland. Its in-house team of 50+ specialists builds digital products and custom web applications for enterprise clients and public-sector organizations across Europe and the Middle East.

Crafton developed this plugin as a free tool for the WordPress community, applying the same internal standards for performance, structure, and user experience that the agency applies in its client projects.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the crafton-pl-aeo-seo-auditor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any Post or Page to see the auditor meta box.
